content: Postgres native declarative partitioning (v10+) by RANGE on a timestamp column is standard for high-write time-series tables; monthly granularity is the common default. pg_partman automates partition creation/retention (run_maintenance_proc scheduled via pg_cron or its background worker) but is an optional operational nicety, not required to get correctness from declarative partitioning itself -- a manual monthly-partition-creation migration/cron is a valid MVP substitute if pg_partman extension isn't available in the hosting environment.
